nodes.name: GitHub deploy webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name X-Webhook-Secret, value = GitHub secret N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Wrong/missing header → 403.

nodes.name: Normalize payload
nodes.notes: Edit CONFIG at the top: Jira site, release-notes field, Google Chat space URL.
